title: A Glasshouse for the Silence
author: Yara Coldharbour
blurb: Mara Crane, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
